welcome_message.name: welcome_message
welcome_message.default: 'Welcome to my scheduling page. Please follow the instructions to add an event to my calendar.'

schedules_one_default_uq.name: schedules_one_default_uq
schedules_one_default_uq.where: is_default and event_type_id is null and single_use_link_id is null and deleted_at is null

event_types_user_slug_uq.name: event_types_user_slug_uq
event_types_user_slug_uq.where: team_id is null and scope = 'personal' and type = 'standard' and deleted_at is null

event_types_team_slug_uq.name: event_types_team_slug_uq
event_types_team_slug_uq.where: team_id is not null and deleted_at is null

cal_conn_account_uq.name: cal_conn_account_uq
cal_conn_account_uq.where: provider_account_id is not null and status <> 'disconnected'

sched_poll_active_uq.name: sched_poll_active_uq
sched_poll_active_uq.where: status = 'active' and poll_id is not null

sched_one_off_active_uq.name: sched_one_off_active_uq
sched_one_off_active_uq.where: status = 'active' and one_off_meeting_id is not null

poll_options_unique_time_uq.name: poll_options_unique_time_uq
poll_options_unique_time_uq.where: deleted_at is null and starts_at is not null

poll_options_unique_day_uq.name: poll_options_unique_day_uq
poll_options_unique_day_uq.where: deleted_at is null and all_day_date is not null

poll_option_shape_ck.name: poll_option_shape_ck
poll_option_shape_ck.value: (starts_at is not null and ends_at is not null and all_day_date is null and ends_at > starts_at) or (starts_at is null and ends_at is null and all_day_date is not null)

poll_participant_email_uq.name: poll_participant_email_uq
poll_participant_email_uq.where: email_normalized is not null and deleted_at is null

deliveries_fanout_uq.name: deliveries_fanout_uq
deliveries_fanout_uq.where: domain_event_id is not null and redelivery_of_id is null
